title: Gemini 4 Argon is now available for everyone
summary: Google opens its latest frontier model to developers, enterprises, and Gemini app subscribers worldwide. Argon runs a 1M unified input-output token limit and launches at an introductory $2 per million input tokens.

title: Meta's Muse Wonder aims at personal superintelligence
summary: Meta ships Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full with Active Memory and Active Focus — the most capable models yet on personal and professional agentic tasks, trained at gigawatt scale.

title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
summary: OpenAI brings GPT-6 to more than 1.2 billion weekly ChatGPT users. Intelligent UI lets answers compose graphics, tappable buttons, forms, and charts inside the conversation.

title: Claude Haiku 5.5 is out
summary: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5 — the fast tier of the Claude family gets a full point release as Mistral simultaneously ships Large 4.
